'''Raygar's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]''' was a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] used by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Raygar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It contained a large [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and a brig.
